prompts.relay: Use case: background-extraction. Production transparent PNG desktop-avatar asset. Reference image is the original approved DARK GLASS concept board. Extract and refine ONE sculpture only: bottom row Relay: compact triangular knot of three broad straight faceted prisms, small triangular opening, same chirality. Use BLUE column as exact shape/material reference. Dark obsidian/smoked charcoal glass, faceted black and dark graphite body with narrow neutral silver edge highlights and electric blue/cyan internal luminous channels, as in the reference. Keep silhouette, proportions, viewpoint and identity. Center the single sculpture in a square transparent canvas with consistent 12% clear padding around it. Object occupies about 76% of canvas. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the sculpture INCLUDING its central hole where applicable. No backdrop, no checkerboard painted in, no floor/reflection or cast shadow, no external halo, no text or labels, no frame, no grid or other objects, no eyes/face/limbs. Preserve the DARK body, don't turn it into clear white glass. Only BLUE and CYAN saturated lights for runtime color remapping. The output is one isolated ready-to-use asset, not a concept board.
